text:
maria: heads-up, monitoring picked up a spike on the canary for v2.14.3 5s ago — write errors to user_profiles. paging oncall-db and release-eng.

jon: joining. error from app logs: `ERROR: Unknown column 'last_login'` when service attempts to write. canary traffic started ~2m ago.

incident-bot: New INCIDENT created (P1). Affected: auth-service writes to user_profiles. Suggested runbook: pause rollout, check migrations and replica lag, apply kill-switch if needed.

sasha: maria, do you want to pause traffic now?

maria: yes. pause canary and flip api-v2 feature flag off. low-risk first.

maria: `POST https://flags.redwood.internal/api/flags` payload: `{ "flag":"api-v2-enabled", "value":false }`

deploy-bot: Received request to stop_canary for v2.14.3. Reverting canary hosts to v2.14.2.

lee: customer dashboards show increased 5xx rate in EU. Alerting threshold may be hit in 12m. I'll draft a status message.

jon: quick db check: primary reports migration job completed. replicas show varying Seconds_Behind_Master. replica-9 shows:
```
Slave_IO_Running: Yes
Slave_SQL_Running: No
Last_SQL_Error: Unknown column 'last_login' in 'field list'
Seconds_Behind_Master: 95
```
Looks like the migration applied partially and the SQL thread crashed on replica.

maria: so traffic routed reads to that replica during canary? that explains errors.

jon: yep. the migration includes an UPDATE step that touches all rows and hits a legacy row-trigger which throws for certain edge rows. On primary it succeeded but left the SQL thread on replica choking.

sasha: plan options: 1) force replicas to reapply migration after patching trigger; 2) roll back schema on primary; 3) keep rollback but leave data to be reconciled later. Which is lowest risk?

maria: kill-flag done, canary stopped. prefer fixing replicas then resume once caught up. avoids data rollback.

jon: investigating minimal fix. Idea: move problematic rows to temp table, run the UPDATE in smaller batches with trigger suppressed, then replay. Will need a short maintenance script on the affected replicas.

db-bot: Note: automatic replication retry will not proceed while Last_SQL_Error persists. Manual intervention required.

jon: executing safe steps on replica-9: create temp table, copy failing rows, apply updates with trigger-disabled session, then resume SQL thread. Commands (run as dba):
```
CREATE TABLE tmp_user_fix AS SELECT id, created_at FROM user_profiles WHERE <trigger_predicate> LIMIT 500;
-- apply updates in batch
UPDATE user_profiles SET last_login = created_at WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM tmp_user_fix);
START SLAVE;
```
I'll run this on replicas sequentially.

maria: how long until replicas are healthy?

jon: estimate 20-35 minutes for the slowest replica. replicas currently spread across EU-A, EU-B.

lee: status note draft: "We've paused a canary rollout for v2.14.3 after a schema mismatch caused a subset of write failures. We stopped the rollout and are repairing replicas. No evidence of data loss; affected requests may have failed during the window." Add ETA 45m.

sasha: marking handoff to SRE at 1960000400 for monitoring. I'll take post-mitigation watch.

jon: replica-9 SQL thread restarted, catching up: Seconds_Behind_Master now 12. No new SQL errors. Proceeding to run the targeted small-batch updates on replica-11 and replica-12 next.

maria: confirm feature flag remains off and no canary traffic.

deploy-bot: canary traffic reverted. No v2.14.3 instances receiving production reads/writes.

jon: after fixes, replicas are within 5s of master across the fleet. performed consistency checks for 240 affected rows. Verified primary and replicas have same counts for affected table.

lee: published status update and pinged support. No customer escalations yet.

incident-bot: Handoff completed at 1960000400 to sasha for 2hr monitoring.

sasha: monitoring metrics now: error rate normal, replication stable. I'll keep this thread open for 30m watch.

maria: creating postmortem ticket: root cause = release started while replicas were lagging; migration contained an UPDATE that triggered legacy trigger on replicas. Corrective actions: enforce pre-rollout replica lag gate (Seconds_Behind_Master < 5), avoid in-place large UPDATEs in migrations, add replica health check to rollout pipeline.

jon: adding PR link to migration tooling that will add a preflight check and avoid triggers by using idempotent backfills.

lee: thanks all. recommend we also add an automated kill-switch to rollout pipeline so a failing migration can auto-stop canary traffic.

db-bot: Incident resolved by maria at 1960000489. Severity downgraded.

maria: closing for now. We'll schedule a postmortem and action items. Reopen if any regression.
